# Troy Hunt

> > Troy Hunt is a Microsoft MVP and renowned cybersecurity expert providing security education, breach analysis, and commentary on data privacy through his Have I Been Pwned service and regular security updates.

Troy Hunt's site serves as a hub for cybersecurity education, incident response analysis, and expert commentary on data breaches. The site features the popular Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) service, regular weekly security updates, workshops, and speaking engagements focused on helping developers and organizations understand and prevent security vulnerabilities.

## Key Topics

- Have I Been Pwned (HIBP)
- Data Breaches
- Web Application Security
- Cybersecurity
- Incident Response
- Security Training
- Developer Education
- Privacy
- IoT Security
- Breach Disclosure
- Workshops
- Security Incidents
- Ransomware
- Social Media Security
- Vulnerability Exploitation

## Security Education & Training

- [Hack Yourself First Workshops](https://www.troyhunt.com/workshops): Hack Yourself First workshop on web application security and vulnerability exploitation
- [Data Breach Disclosure 101: How to Succeed After You've Failed](https://www.troyhunt.com/data-breach-disclosure-101-how-to-succeed-after-youve-failed): Guide on data breach disclosure best practices using CloudPets case study

## Breach Analysis & Case Studies

- [CloudPets Data Breach: Children's Voice Messages Exposed](https://www.troyhunt.com/data-from-connected-cloudpets-teddy-bears-leaked-and-ransomed-exposing-kids-voice-messages): Analysis of CloudPets IoT breach exposing children's voice messages
- [Weekly Update 495: HIBP Serverless Architecture](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-495): Weekly update on HIBP serverless architecture and performance improvements
- [Weekly Update 494: Recent Data Breaches](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-494): Weekly update on recent data breaches including Odido and KomikoAI
- [Weekly Update 493: Odido Data Breach](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-493): Weekly update on Odido data breach in Netherlands
- [Weekly Update 492: Data Breaches and Ransomware](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-492): Weekly update on data breaches and ransomware incidents
- [Weekly Update 491: IoT Security and Smart Lock Vulnerabilities](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-491): Weekly update on IoT security and smart lock vulnerabilities with ESP32
- [Weekly Update 489: INTERPOL Cybercrime](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-489): Weekly update on INTERPOL cybercrime and youth intervention initiatives
- [Weekly Update 488: Social Media Age Verification](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-488): Weekly update on UK and Australia social media age verification policies
- [Weekly Update 487: Privacy and AI-Generated Content](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-487): Weekly update on privacy, AI-generated content, and solar energy
- [Weekly Update 486: WhiteDate Breach](https://www.troyhunt.com/weekly-update-486): Weekly update on WhiteDate breach and NDC conference in Oslo
